ui.tagline: A hotel murder mystery you solve together, each on your own phone.
ui.waitingHost: Waiting for {name} to open the case…
ui.tapClue: Tap a clue to cross it off for everyone.
ui.tapStaffThenSquare: Tap a staff member, then tap a square.
ui.tapSquarePlace: Tap a square to put them there. Tap them again to take them off.
ui.tapSquareRuleOut: Tap squares where they cannot be.
ui.whoDidItBody: {victim} was found in the {room}. Pick the staff member who was alone with them.
ui.solvedIn: Solved in {time} with {players} detective(s), {strikes} wrong accusation(s).
ui.threeWrong: Three wrong accusations after {time}. The solved plan is on the board.
ui.waitingHostAgain: Waiting for the host to open another case…
ui.nobodyOnVictim: Nobody on staff can stand on the victim's spot.
ui.pickStaffFirst: Pick a staff member below first.
ui.helpHint: The culprit is the only staff member in the {room} with {victim}.
rules.1: Six staff were each on a different row and a different column of the floor plan. Nobody stood on the 💀 spot.
rules.2: Use the clues to place everyone. North is up, west is left. Beside means directly up, down, left or right.
rules.3: The culprit is the only staff member in the same room as the victim.
rules.4: When the board is full, accuse. Three wrong accusations and the culprit walks free.
clue.alone: {a} was alone in their room, with no other staff inside.
clue.together: {a} and {b} were in the same room.
clue.count.zero: Nobody on staff was in the {room}.
clue.count.one: Exactly one staff member was in the {room}.
error.notInRoom: You are not in a room.
error.serverError: Something went wrong on the server.
error.hotelFull: The hotel is full right now. Try again in a few minutes.
error.couldNotCreate: Could not create a room. Try again.
error.noSuchRoom: No room with that code. Check it and try again.
error.roomFull: That room is full (8 players max).
error.notInRoomAnymore: You are no longer in that room.
error.hostOnly: Only the host can do that.
error.alreadyPlaying: A case is already in progress.
error.noPuzzles: No puzzles are available for that difficulty.
error.victimCell: Nobody on staff can stand there.
error.placeAllFirst: Place all six staff on the plan before accusing anyone.
log.lose: {who} accused {accused}. That was strike {strikes}. The culprit got away.
log.wrongSuspect: Wrong suspect. Who is alone with the victim?
log.wrongBoard: The board does not add up. Recheck the clues.
